items.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
items.content: https://deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-3-8-flash/ --- Top Comments --- [simonw]: The speed combined with the fact that this thing is really good at HTML JavaScript is pretty exciting. Here's what I got for 1.8 cents and 13 seconds from the prompt "make me a cool thing in html": https://gisthost.github.io/?6a77bc41a81718c6aaa10d4ab243c59f Transcript here (it was part of a chat): https://gist.github.com/simonw/b6149a49d327164d67d62c3d12992... [jampa]: I've been using Gemini 3.7 for my personal trip planning app. Across multiple benchmarks, it ranks higher on everything I tried: - Real world knowledge (when a thing opens and closes, the geographic region, historical facts). It's also the best at taking a cluster of places and working out a visiting order. - Photo ranking (which photo should be the hero). Gemini can tell whether a photo is of the thing or of the view from it. - Document parsing (extracting the relevant trip info fr... [mattlondon]: Currently top at https://deepswe.datacurve.ai - beating Opus 5! https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/gemini-3-8-flash shows an intelligence score of 59, the same as Opus 5 medium! Wow - for a flash model this seems to benchmark powerfully. Remains to be seen what it is like to use. [simonw]: Pelicans (thinking effort high, medium, low): https://tools.simonwillison.net/markdown-svg-renderer?url=ht... - high cost 8.9742 cents Here are the 3.7 pelicans for comparison: https://tools.simonwillison.net/markdown-svg-renderer.html?u... - high cost 8.4387 cents (I think thinking level low is a regression on 3.8 compared to 3.7.) [simonw]: The most interesting thing about the Gemini models is still their multi-modal support: they accept audio and video input, OpenAI and Anthropic's flagships are still image-only. Gemini Flash is also pretty cheap, so it's a great family for performing media analysis, like extracting structured data from images and video.
items.summary: Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber models are released, drawing enthusiastic attention for speed, low cost, and strong performance.
items.detailed_summary_zh: Google（DeepMind）发布了 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 3.8 Flash Cyber 模型，主打低延迟、低成本和高性能。开发者的实测显示，它用约 1.8 美分和 13 秒即可从一句提示生成含 HTML/JavaScript 的交互页面，并称其具备出色的多模态能力，可接受音频和视频输入，而 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的旗舰模型目前仍只支持图像输入。在 Artificial Analysis 上，Gemini 3.8 Flash 的智能得分达到 59，与 Opus 5 medium 持平，并在 DeepSwe 排行榜上暂时超过 Opus 5。当前模型卡已由 DeepMind 发布，但实际使用体验仍待观察。
items.background_zh: Gemini Flash 是 Google DeepMind 推出的高效低成本模型系列，定位在更快的响应速度与更低的价格下提供接近旗舰模型的推理和编码能力。此次发布的 Gemini 3.8 是六周内第三个 Flash 版本，仍保持与 3.7 Flash 相同的速度和低成本，并宣称是其迄今最好的推理与编程模型。3.8 Flash Cyber 则基于同一个核心模型，但通过安全访问封装面向网络安全等专业场景，取代了此前的 3.5 版本。

items.title: Muse Spark 1.3
items.content: https://research.meta.ai/blog/introducing-muse-spark-1-3 --- Top Comments --- [simonw]: llm -m meta-ai/muse-spark-1.3 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" https://tools.simonwillison.net/markdown-svg-renderer?url=ht... 4.2266 cents, 38 seconds. For comparison here's Muse Spark 1.2, which animated it without me asking it to: https://tools.simonwillison.net/markdown-svg-renderer?url=ht... The 1.3 one is definitely better - better bicycle frame, better wing, better pelican hat. UPDATE: Here's another one with ... [superfrank]: I started using Spark 1.2 for development because if you're willing to let Meta train on your data it was dirt cheap and was actually really pleasantly surprised with it. It's not a frontier model by any means, but for work that didn't require a top of the line model, I really enjoyed using it. I'm anthropomorphizing it a bit, but it felt like it knew its weaknesses and didn't try to impose it's opinions on me. What I mean by that is that it did what I told it an... [bertili]: DeepSWE scores 75.4 - that's the best score so far. And it's crazy cheap! Google held the top a few hours today with Gemini 3.8 Flash, but now second to Spark 1.3. All this competition will drive prices down! [Lucasoato]: A model that (at least in benchmarks) is getting closer to SOTA. A clear separation between what’s used to improve their products and what’s not (at least this is what they claim). Good job Meta! Seriously. This is almost making me forget about the 18B$ lawsuit for children social media addiction. [jmward01]: muse-spark-1.3-contributor. Say what you want and Meta, changing the pricing to explicitly say 'we train on this and value it this much' is what every model provider should do. As a side note, it is now completely obvious how much stealing my tokens for training is worth to model providers. I avoid/pay extra/try my best to make sure I am not getting trained on but it seems like it keeps popping up that I missed a setting somewhere. This is the first quantifiable number I h...
items.summary: Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 delivers competitive coding-agent performance at a very low cost, drawing strong developer interest.
items.detailed_summary_zh: Meta 发布了 Muse Spark 1.3，这是面向编码智能体场景的新模型，在 DeepSWE 基准上取得 75.4 分，成为目前公开的最好成绩，超过了当天早些时候由 Google Gemini 3.8 Flash 短暂保持的榜首。该模型的最大卖点是极低的成本，例如有开发者测试生成一张 SVG 只花费约 4.2266 美分、耗时 38 秒，且质量相比 Muse Spark 1.2 有明显提升。Meta 同时提供 contributor 版本，明确说明会使用用户数据训练模型，并因此给予更低价格。整体看，这是一次高性价比的增量升级，而不是范式级别的突破。
items.background_zh: Muse Spark 是 Meta 面向开发者的编码与智能体模型系列，通过 Meta Model API 提供。此前 Muse Spark 1.2 已把价格压低至每百万输入 token 1.25 美元、每百万输出 token 4.25 美元；该系列还引入了 muse-spark-1.2-contributor 分层，以每百万输入 0.10 美元、输出 0.20 美元的极低价格，换取 Meta 使用提示词与输出训练后续模型。这次发布的 Muse Spark 1.3 延续这一产品线，并宣称在部分基准上刷新纪录。

items.title: Chevron to double Venezuela oil production with $7bn pledge
items.content: US major commits to expanding its joint ventures as White House pushes for huge increase in production in the country
items.summary: Chevron commits $7bn to double its Venezuela oil production by expanding joint ventures, backed by US government pressure.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 美国石油巨头雪佛龙承诺投入70亿美元，通过扩大当地合资企业业务，使在委内瑞拉的石油产量增加一倍。这一投资是在美国政府施压大幅提高委内瑞拉产量的背景下提出的。
items.background_zh: 雪佛龙正在扩大其在委内瑞拉的合资项目。据路透社报道，该公司计划通过其委内瑞拉合资企业投资超过70亿美元，在未来五年内将石油日产量翻倍至约60万桶；这一举措与白宫推动委内瑞拉大幅增产的背景相关。

items.title: Energy price surge hits bond markets as European gas reaches three-year high
items.content: US 10-year borrowing costs touch highest since 2023 as fears of return to full-blown Iran conflict rise
items.summary: Energy price surge and geopolitical tensions push European gas to a three-year high and US 10-year yields to their highest since 2023.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 欧洲天然气价格升至三年新高，同时美国10年期国债收益率触及2023年以来最高水平，原因之一是市场担忧伊朗冲突可能再度全面升级。
items.background_zh: 此前伊朗战争担忧推高能源成本，欧洲天然气价格已升至2023年1月以来最高，基准荷兰天然气合约一度触及每兆瓦时75.325欧元的43个月高点；全球债券市场同步遭抛售，美国10年期国债收益率因通胀担忧和突破40万亿美元的政府债务压力升至2023年以来最高。

items.title: Shein finally launched its cut-price IPO. Now comes the hard part
items.content: Ultra-fast-fashion retailer set to prioritise third-party marketplace in growth push after cut-price listing
items.summary: Shein launched a cut-price IPO and now plans to push growth through its third-party marketplace, marking a key strategic shift.
items.detailed_summary_zh: Shein 已完成一场估值下调的首次公开募股（IPO），接下来计划将增长重心转向第三方市场平台。此次战略转变意味着，公司将更多依靠外部卖家扩充商品种类，而不只依赖自营快时尚业务。
items.background_zh: Shein 以较低估值上市后，正把增长重点转向第三方市场（允许其他商家和品牌直接在平台上销售），以拓展产品品类和地域市场，并把收入来源从自有产品销售扩展到交易佣金和广告推广。

items.title: US government sides with OpenAI on issue of training LLMs on copyrighted material
items.content:
"The United States has a strong interest in continuing to develop a robust and competitive artificial intelligence industry that sets the standard for the practice and procedure of AI use
globally," the brief reads.
items.summary: US government backs OpenAI in a copyright case concerning the training of large language models, signaling support for the AI industry.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 美国政府在一份法庭文件中表示支持OpenAI，涉及其使用受版权保护材料训练大语言模型的案件。文件中写道，美国在继续发展强大且具有竞争力的AI产业方面具有强烈利益，并希望为全球AI使用实践树立标准。这一立场可能为OpenAI在版权诉讼中提供支持，并影响未来有关AI训练的法律先例。目前尚不清楚案件的具体细节及最终结果。
items.background_zh: 美国政府在《纽约时报》起诉OpenAI的版权诉讼中提交了一份20页的法庭之友意见书，支持OpenAI的立场。政府认为，使用受版权保护的材料训练大型语言模型属于合理使用，并强调限制这一行为将阻碍人工智能行业的创新和美国的经济竞争力。该案的核心争议在于生成式AI公司未经许可使用版权内容进行模型训练是否构成侵权，而美国政府的表态为AI行业在此类争议中提供了重要支持。

items.summary: Google avoids a court-ordered breakup of its ad tech business, defeating the U.S. government's antitrust bid.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 谷歌击败美国政府的反垄断请求，避免法院下令拆分其广告技术业务。该业务去年收入为300亿美元，约占母公司Alphabet收入的8%；但分析师估计它占Alphabet利润的比重不到1%。
items.background_zh: 美国政府在反垄断诉讼中曾要求谷歌出售广告技术业务，理由是谷歌在网络广告交易链条上占据主导地位。

items.title: Palo Alto Networks paid $500M for Thrive-backed Console, sources say
items.content: The acquisition also leaves Sequoia-backed Serval as the de facto startup leader in AI IT service automation, industry watchers believe.
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks reportedly acquired Thrive-backed Console for $500M, reshaping the AI IT service automation startup hierarchy.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据报道，Palo Alto Networks以5亿美元收购了Thrive支持的AI IT服务自动化初创公司Console，但该价格来自匿名消息来源，尚未得到官方证实。行业观察人士认为，这笔交易后，红杉资本支持的Serval成为AI IT服务自动化领域事实上的领先初创公司。
items.background_zh: Palo Alto Networks 是一家总部位于美国加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉的网络安全公司。据 TechCrunch 报道，这笔收购是该公司2026年进行的第七笔收购；此次收购完成后，业内认为 Sequoia 投资的 Serval 成为 AI IT 服务自动化领域最受关注的初创公司之一。

items.title: Wonderful more than doubles its valuation to $5B in under 6 months
items.content: Wonderful said it will use its $550 million Series C funding to develop products faster, expand its FDE teams, and meet demand for its products.
items.summary: Wonderful raised $550 million in Series C funding, doubling its valuation to $5 billion in under six months.
items.detailed_summary_zh: Wonderful 在 C 轮融资中筹集 5.5 亿美元，并称其估值在不到 6 个月内增长逾一倍，达到 50 亿美元。该公司表示将用这笔资金加快产品开发、扩充 FDE 团队并满足产品需求。
items.background_zh: Wonderful 是一家总部位于阿姆斯特丹、由以色列和荷兰合资的人工智能初创公司，主要开发协调企业内 AI 代理的软件。该公司在 2026 年 3 月完成 1.5 亿美元 B 轮融资，估值为 20 亿美元；此次 5.5 亿美元 C 轮融资由 Insight Partners 领投，Salesforce 作为新投资者加入，估值升至 50 亿美元。

items.title: Australian Earnings Beat Estimates for First Time in Four Years
items.content: Australian earnings beats are outpacing misses for the first time in four years, defying a challenging economic backdrop and bolstering chances for a stalled stock rally to resume.
items.summary: Australian companies are beating earnings estimates for the first time in four years, potentially helping a stalled stock rally resume.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据彭博社报道，澳大利亚企业财报表现超预期的数量首次超过未达预期的数量，为四年来头一回；这可能有助于此前停滞的股市反弹重新启动。
items.background_zh: 此前四年澳大利亚企业盈利持续未达分析师预期，本次财报季首次出现超预期数量多于未达预期，背景是经济环境充满挑战，股市涨势一度停滞。

items.title: CrowdStrike and federal authorities dismantle Russian malware that secretly stole crypto for 8 years
items.summary: CrowdStrike and federal authorities have dismantled Russian malware that secretly stole cryptocurrency for eight years.
items.detailed_summary_zh: Cyber安全公司CrowdStrike与联邦当局联合瓦解了一个俄罗斯恶意软件行动，该恶意软件在过去八年里一直在秘密窃取加密货币。目前报道没有披露恶意软件的具体名称、感染渠道或被盗资金规模，也没有提供相关技术细节。此次行动体现了安全企业与执法部门合作应对长期加密货币盗窃威胁的进展。由于缺少官方公告的更多信息，该事件对普通用户的具体影响尚不明确。
items.background_zh: Sality 是一个自 2003 年起活跃的俄罗斯僵尸网络恶意软件，其作案方式是利用剪贴板劫持：监视用户复制的比特币和以太坊地址，并在粘贴时悄悄替换为攻击者控制的地址。据报道，过去八年间该恶意软件至少窃取了 1210 万卢布（约 15 万美元）的加密货币；CrowdStrike 与美国司法部、联邦调查局等联邦机构合作，拆除了相关基础设施并取缔了这一犯罪网络。

items.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
items.content: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.
items.summary: OpenAI's Astra model will reportedly use 'recurrent depth' to move beyond sequential reasoning, but details are limited.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据 TechCrunch 报道，OpenAI 的新模型 Astra 将采用名为“递归深度”（recurrent depth）的技术，使它能够脱离大多数推理模型所依赖的逐步顺序推理机制。报道称，这一新的推理方式已引起 AI 安全专家的警惕。目前公开的技术细节仍然很少，尚不清楚该方法的具体实现方式、可能的收益以及风险。由于信息来源有限，有关专家担忧的具体内容还未得到披露。
items.background_zh: OpenAI 的 Astra 模型据报将采用“循环深度”（recurrent depth）技术，这种设计会在生成下一个词元之前，让信息多次通过同一组 Transformer 层，而非像多数推理模型那样只按顺序思考一步。相关报道首先由 The Information 于 9 月 1 日披露，目前公开技术细节仍十分有限，也引发了部分 AI 安全专家对可解释性与控制风险的担忧。

items.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
items.summary: Kraken parent Payward delays its IPO to at least Q2 2027.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 据CoinDesk报道，加密货币交易所Kraken的母公司Payward已将首次公开募股（IPO）推迟到最早2027年第二季度。
items.background_zh: Kraken母公司Payward此前在2026年3月因市场状况困难而搁置上市计划，如今又据知情人士称，其IPO（首次公开募股）最早要到2027年第二季度才会推进。

items.title: New Jersey becomes first state to ask Supreme Court to weigh in on prediction markets
items.summary: New Jersey has become the first state to ask the U.S. Supreme Court to examine prediction markets.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 新泽西州成为美国第一个请求联邦最高法院审理预测市场相关事宜的州；这一请求尚属早期法律程序，并非法院裁决或既定政策变化。
items.background_zh: 新泽西州已请求美国最高法院审理其与预测市场的监管纠纷，成为第一个就此问题向最高法院请愿的州。预测市场是允许人们就未来事件下注的平台，例如Kalshi。此前，联邦第三巡回上诉法院在4月以2比1裁定，新泽西州赌博监管机构不能阻止预测市场公司接受体育赛事投注，新泽西州现在寻求推翻这一裁决。

items.title: Bitcoin slips below $76,500 as U.S. strikes on Iran send oil above $93
items.summary: Bitcoin falls below $76,500 while oil rises above $93 following U.S. military strikes on Iran.
items.detailed_summary_zh: 美国对伊朗发动军事打击后，比特币跌至76,500美元下方，油价升至每桶93美元上方。
items.background_zh: 这是2026年伊朗冲突期间美国再次对伊朗发动军事打击后的市场反应。此前8月底的首轮打击曾令比特币基本持稳，但最新的新一轮打击使油价升至约三个月高位，同时比特币跌破76,500美元，反映避险情绪抬升、资金撤离加密货币等风险资产。
